🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. log —— 取自然对数
    log(divide(divide(ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 0), 20), ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), 1, 0), 20)), divide(ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) >= 0), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 0), 20), ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) >= 0), 1, 0), 20))))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(divide(ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 0), 20), ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), 1, 0), 20)), divide(ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) >= 0), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 0), 20), ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) >= 0), 1, 0), 20)))
  3. 3. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 0), 20), ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), 1, 0), 20))
  4. 4. ts_sum —— 过去 N 天滚动求和
    ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 0), 20)
  5. 5. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 0)
  6. 6. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  7. 7. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)

    ts_sum(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), 1, 0), 20)

  12. 12. ts_sum —— 过去 N 天滚动求和

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  2. 计算 down：ret < 0
  3. 计算 up：ret >= 0
  4. 计算 range_：high - low
  5. 计算 down_range：range_.where(down, 0)
  6. 计算 up_range：range_.where(up, 0)
  7. 计算 down_sum：down_range.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).sum()
  8. 计算 up_sum：up_range.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).sum()
  9. 计算 down_count：down.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).sum()
  10. 计算 up_count：up.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).sum()
  11. 计算 down_avg：down_sum / down_count
  12. 计算 up_avg：up_sum / up_count
  13. 计算 ratio：down_avg / up_avg
  14. 计算 factor：np.log(ratio.clip(lower=1e-6))

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_asym_ratio_pure(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change() down = ret < 0 up = ret >= 0 range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"] down_range = range_.where(down, 0) up_range = range_.where(up, 0) down_sum = down_range.rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum() up_sum = up_range.rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum() down_count = down.rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum() up_count = up.rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum() down_avg = down_sum / down_count.replace(0, np.nan) up_avg = up_sum / up_count.replace(0, np.nan) ratio = down_avg / up_avg.replace(0, np.nan) factor = np.log(ratio.clip(lower=1e-6)) df_copy["factor_asym_ratio_pure"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_asym_ratio_pure"]
